en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy coastal waterfront with many small boats in a harbor and crowds along the quayside. Behind the harbor is a line of low waterfront houses, and further up the hill stands a large rectangular institutional building identified as 'Casa Caridad'. At the bottom margin appears a printed caption in red, and there is a handwritten message in English across the lower front. A circular library stamp is visible in the upper right area.
